addr: 150, Margosa Rd, above Axis bank, above Punjab mail, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: Very old and small hall for conducting small functions, get togethers etc. It can accommodate around 150 people max. Premises is okay nothing much to appreciate. The hall needs improvement in many areas. The major drawback of this hall is it doesn't have any parking space of its own.

Most dirtiest party hall I have ever seen. Located in the ever busy  Margosa Road, Malleshwaram proximity is the only plus point. No parking place, highly conjusted Hall. It's so dirty, one may not feel to have the food also..
Nice place for small functions with facilities. People are helpful and approachable. Very much affordable. On main near market.
